image-cropper.formula:
Output width = selection width in pixels
Output height = selection height in pixels
With an aspect lock: height = width / ratio, e.g. for 16:9, height = width / 1.7778
Example: a 1200 px wide selection at 16:9 gives 1200 / 1.7778 = 675 px tall.
howTo: Click the file picker and choose a photo from your device (up to 15 MB).
Drag on the image to draw the crop box, or pick an aspect preset to get a centered selection instantly.
Fine-tune the box by dragging again from any corner until the highlighted area is exactly what you want.
Press the Crop button to render the selection at full resolution.
Preview the result and press Download to save the PNG to your device.

You upload a 4000 x 3000 px photo and want a 16:9 banner.
